action_type_desc: Select the type of action to perform
button_display_style_desc: Choose a unified display style for all buttons in the panel
button_icon_desc: Upload, search, or enter an icon
button_name_invalid_chars: Button name cannot contain special characters < > : " / \ | ? *
button_panel_view_desc: Choose the display mode for the button panel: list view or tabs view
category_layout_desc: How the buttons of this category are arranged.
category_layout_flow_hint: Buttons follow each other and close up the gap when one is removed or hidden by a context rule.
category_layout_grid_hint: A field of fixed slots, resizable from 1x1 up to 5x5 in edit mode. Every button keeps its position; an empty slot stays empty instead of moving the others. Arrange the slots by dragging buttons in edit mode.
category_layout_too_many_buttons: This category has {count} buttons but the grid only has {slots} slots. Remove or move buttons before switching to the grid layout.
conditions_desc: Show this button only when the rules below match the active note (applied in locked mode; in edit mode hidden buttons stay visible and manageable). Leave empty to always show it.
context_status_contextual_inactive: Context rule — not matching right now, hidden in locked mode
grid_slot_empty_tooltip: Empty slot (row {row}, column {column}) — drag a button here
conditions_category_desc: Category visibility: show this category only when the rules below match the active note and at least one of its buttons is visible (applied in locked mode; in edit mode hidden categories stay visible and manageable). For a dynamic category the variant triggers decide the content — leave this empty to always show the category.
conditions_empty_group_hint: Empty group — add a rule or group.
conditions_invalid_structure: Conditions JSON does not match the condition schema
conditions_incomplete: Conditions are incomplete — fill in all rule fields
confirm_delete_button: Are you sure you want to delete button "{buttonName}"?
confirm_delete_category: Are you sure you want to delete category "{categoryName}"?
create_paths_desc: Click to automatically create folders if they do not exist.
delete_button_warning: ⚠️ Warning: This action cannot be undone.
delete_category_warning: ⚠️ Warning: This category contains {buttonCount} buttons. Deleting the category will also delete all buttons!
enable_button_animation_desc: Enable hover animation effects for buttons
show_button_tooltip_desc: Display the full button name as a tooltip when hovering over a button
file_name_desc: Enter a file name (support date variable)
script_file_desc: Select a JavaScript file to run
script_file_empty: Script file path cannot be empty
script_folder_desc: Folder path for storing script files
script_invalid_export:
Invalid script export. Use module.exports = { entry: main, ... } and make sure entry is a function. Please check your script:
{scriptFileName}
folder_name_editable_desc: Click the folder name to edit when expanded
folder_show_btn_count_desc: Display the number of buttons on the folder tile
folder_close_on_blank_desc: Click on any empty area inside the expanded folder to close it
template_folder_desc: Folder path for storing template files
no_categories_hint: No categories yet, switch to edit mode to add
no_buttons_in_category: No buttons yet, switch to edit mode to add
stop_on_error_desc: Whether to stop executing subsequent actions when one fails
delay_between_actions_desc: Delay time between actions in sequential execution (milliseconds)
sequence_stopped_on_error: Action sequence stopped due to error
only_sequential_effective: This option is only effective in sequential mode
show_top_nav_bar_desc: Control the display/hide of top navigation bar
tabs_wrap_desc: When enabled, tabs will automatically wrap to the next line based on page width instead of horizontal scrolling
auto_collapse_list_view_desc: When enabled, each time you open list view, all categories start collapsed
category_layout_dynamic_refused: This dynamic category holds several complete variants, which a flow list cannot represent. Delete variants first, or keep the grid layout.
grid_drop_occupied: That slot is already taken. Drop a tool from a flow category onto an empty slot.
variant_trigger_row_tooltip: Trigger of the variant you are editing. If several variants match the current context, the one higher in the list wins. Edit it via the variant options menu.
variant_active_row_tooltip: Variant the current Obsidian context resolves to — what locked mode would show right now.
variant_name_desc: Shown in the variant selector, for example “Source” or “Topic”.
variant_fallback_desc: Shown only when no other variant's trigger matches. A category can have one fallback; it has no trigger of its own.
variant_fallback_taken: Another variant is already the fallback. Edit that variant first if you want to change it.
variant_trigger_desc: This variant renders when these rules match the active note. Variants are checked in order and the first match wins — variants are never merged. Leave empty to always match (checked in priority order).
variant_delete_confirm: Delete the variant “{name}”? Its complete grid with {count} tool(s) is deleted with it:
variant_delete_last: A dynamic category needs at least one variant. Delete the whole category instead, if that is what you want.
variant_grid_full: This grid has no free slot left. Add a column or a row, or free a slot first.
variants_section_desc: Complete alternative grids of this dynamic category, in priority order — the first variant whose trigger matches wins; the fallback shows when nothing matches. Edit and reorder them here, or next to the grid itself in edit mode.
grid_button_target_static_desc: This category is a static grid: its tools are always the same. Per-button context rules do not apply inside a grid.
grid_button_target_variant_desc: This tool belongs to the variant “{name}” and appears only while that variant is active. A dynamic category models context through its variants, not through per-button rules.
conditions_view_type_hint: Obsidian view type, e.g. markdown, pdf or canvas.
conditions_file_name_hint: Full file name including the extension, e.g. SRC_Note.md.
category_dynamic_tooltip: Dynamic category — content changes with context
script_outside_script_folder: Tool created — it opens the script file. Run script only finds scripts inside the configured script folder.
grid_handle_column_tooltip: Add a column, or drag to resize (currently {count})
grid_handle_row_tooltip: Add a row, or drag to resize (currently {count})
grid_handle_column_max_tooltip: Maximum of {count} columns — drag to resize
grid_handle_row_max_tooltip: Maximum of {count} rows — drag to resize
grid_remove_columns_confirm: Remove {strips} columns? {count} tools will be deleted.
grid_remove_rows_confirm: Remove {strips} rows? {count} tools will be deleted.
grid_remove_columns_confirm_one: Remove {strips} columns? 1 tool will be deleted.
grid_remove_rows_confirm_one: Remove {strips} rows? 1 tool will be deleted.
grid_remove_column_confirm: Remove the right column? {count} tools will be deleted.
grid_remove_row_confirm: Remove the bottom row? {count} tools will be deleted.
grid_remove_column_confirm_one: Remove the right column? 1 tool will be deleted.
grid_remove_row_confirm_one: Remove the bottom row? 1 tool will be deleted.
template_import_missing: {missing} referenced files were not found in this vault.
template_error_invalid_json: the file is not valid JSON
template_error_not_a_template: the file is not a Dynamic Action Panel template
template_error_unsupported_version: template format version {version} is newer than this Dynamic Action Panel build supports
template_error_dangling_tool: the template references a tool it does not contain ({detail})
template_import_missing_one: 1 referenced file was not found in this vault.
